title: vGLP refusal diagnostics and app wording review

events.outcome: Requested changes on exact Audit PR #180 before accepting vGLP #2. The diagnostic gap is supported by compiler inspection. An ended named request can produce unable([], []) after a successful local domain check; the joined-condition and request-drop paths can both produce bare unable. The proposed widget fallback maps the empty-list and bare encodings to the same constraint-failure explanation. Exact-tree status table regenerated at 36 reports, 67 findings and 13 unanswered, while the summary counts need updating.

project_claims: GCE reports 44 app walks with five persons and 17/18 Library Lend refusals. GLP PR #180 reports two passing notice unit tests.
source_inspection: Compiler retains atoms-only unable reasons, an independent ended-request empty-pair path, and bare unable on joined-condition failure and on a dropped request.
App candidate renders the same value-condition message for bare unable and an empty pair. Supplied fixtures exercise SocialNotice.sentence directly.
The cited walk harness flattens the reason to atom lists. The specific reported counts and their causes were not independently established.
Latest published vGLP PDF blob was identified. Binary retrieval through the GitHub connector did not yield the PDF bytes, so the current section wording was not independently checked.
